purpose: Compare the second seed GPU repeated-step surface with a single-process CPU repeated-eval loop.
preconditions: tlul_sink host probe is built with make -C src/hybrid tlul_sink_host_probe
reports/tlul_sink_repeated_steps_scaling.json exists when CPU/GPU comparison fields are requested

allowed_claims: single-process CPU repeated eval_step wall time for tlul_sink at nstates=512
GPU repeated kernel-launch throughput for tlul_sink at nstates=512
CPU/GPU state-step throughput ratio for the second seed gate shape
non_claims: not a full RTL application throughput claim
target breadth is limited to two OpenTitan TL-UL seeds
CPU repeated steps are modeled as repeated eval_step calls after initialization
comparison_policy.next_precision_step: package the minimal two-seed boundary if this gate shows a GPU win
